subtopic: 05 · Trigonometric Identities and Compound Angle Formulas
title: Signs in a compound angle, a ratio proof, and max/min

board_content.text: $\sin A=\tfrac35$ ($A$ acute $\Rightarrow \cos A=\tfrac45$); $\cos B=-\tfrac{12}{13}$ ($B$ obtuse $\Rightarrow \sin B=\tfrac{5}{13}$).

segments_english.text: These lean on signs, sum-to-product, and the amplitude trick.

Example four: given sine A is three fifths with A acute, so cosine A is four fifths; and cosine B is minus twelve thirteenths with B obtuse, so sine B is plus five thirteenths. The whole difficulty is that sign of sine B, straight from Subtopic two's quadrant rule.

Now sine of A plus B is sine A cosine B plus cosine A sine B: three fifths times minus twelve thirteenths, plus four fifths times five thirteenths. That's minus thirty six plus twenty, over sixty five, giving minus sixteen over sixty five.
Example five, a ratio proof. Convert top and bottom to products.

Sine three A plus sine A is two sine two A cosine A; cosine three A plus cosine A is two cosine two A cosine A. The common factor two cosine A cancels, leaving sine two A over cosine two A, which is tangent two A. Proved.
Example six, a max-min with no calculus. For seven cosine x plus twenty four sine x, the amplitude R is the square root of seven squared plus twenty four squared, which is twenty five.
So that part swings between minus twenty five and twenty five; add the five and the maximum is thirty, the minimum is minus twenty.

segments_hinglish.text: ये signs, sum-to-product, और amplitude trick पर टिकते हैं.

Example चार: दिया sine A तीन बटा पाँच, A acute, so cosine A four fifths; और cosine B minus twelve thirteenths, B obtuse, so sine B plus five thirteenths. पूरी मुश्किल है sine B का वो sign, सीधे Subtopic two के quadrant rule से.

अब sine of A plus B है sine A cosine B plus cosine A sine B: three fifths times minus twelve thirteenths, plus four fifths times five thirteenths. यानी minus thirty six plus twenty, over sixty five, देता minus sixteen over sixty five.
Example पाँच, एक ratio proof. Top और bottom को products में बदलिए.

Sine three A plus sine A है two sine two A cosine A; cosine three A plus cosine A है two cosine two A cosine A. Common factor two cosine A cancel, बचता sine two A over cosine two A, यानी tangent two A. साबित.
Example छह, बिना calculus max-min. Seven cosine x plus twenty four sine x के लिए, amplitude R है square root of seven squared plus twenty four squared, यानी twenty five.
So वो part minus twenty five से twenty five के बीच झूलता है; five जोड़िए और maximum thirty, minimum minus twenty.
